column1: # The authoritative list of permitted integration-test binaries under
# subset_julia_vm rlib, so every extra binary adds real full-suite BUILD time.
# `scripts/check_test_binary_budget.sh` fails if a tests/*.rs file appears here
# Adding a new binary is therefore a reviewable event: prefer adding a `mod` to
# …). Only add a NEW entry here when process isolation or a distinct
# required-feature genuinely forces a separate binary — see docs/vm/TESTING_GUIDE.md.
# One binary basename (without the .rs extension) per line. `#` starts a comment.
